issue.title: Tooltip stays open after its trigger is removed
issue.body:
### Environment

- @acme/ui: 1.4.0
- Vue: 3.5.13

### Description

A `UTooltip` that is open when its trigger gets removed from the DOM with `v-if` never closes. It stays on screen until the page reloads.

### Reproduction

https://github.com/dmorales/acme-tooltip-repro
